closing.summary: Big strengths are dietary nitrates give it a nitric-oxide angle, quite filling, and whole-food carb package, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin A, low iron, and low protein quality. It is good for low-calorie volume and practical meals because it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure and the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around.
